title: The Passive Voice
sub: 被動語態 be + 過去分詞：強調動作的「承受者」，或動作者不明、不重要時使用；be 隨時態變化。

form.p: 受詞 + be + 過去分詞（+ by 動作者）

uses.d: 誰做的不重要，重點在「被怎麼了」。

ex.s: is made / was made / has been made / will be made / is being made

uses.d: 情態 + be + 過去分詞。

mistakes.no: The letter was wrote yesterday.
mistakes.yes: The letter was written yesterday.
mistakes.why: 被動要用過去分詞 written。

mistakes.no: The accident was happened last night.
mistakes.yes: The accident happened last night.
mistakes.why: happen 是不及物動詞，不能被動。

mistakes.no: English speaks in many countries.
mistakes.yes: English is spoken in many countries.
mistakes.why: 語言被人說，用被動 is spoken。

mistakes.no: This problem can solved easily.
mistakes.yes: This problem can be solved easily.
mistakes.why: 情態被動要有 be：can be solved。

tip: 被動＝be + 過去分詞，強調承受者；be 跟著時態走；不及物動詞（happen, arrive）沒有被動；情態動詞被動要加 be。

q.q: The Mona Lisa ___ by Leonardo da Vinci.
q.why: 過去被動 was painted。

q.q: Rice ___ in many Asian countries.
q.why: 稻米被種，用被動 is grown。

q.q: The homework must ___ by Friday.
q.why: 情態被動 must be finished。

q.q: A new hospital ___ next year.
q.why: 未來被動 will be built。

q.q: Which sentence is correct?
q.why: was + 過去分詞 eaten。

q.q: This song ___ (write) by a famous singer.
q.why: was written。

q.sent: The thief was catch by the police .
q.why: 被動用過去分詞 caught。

q.sent: The room is cleaned every day
q.why: 現在被動 is + 過去分詞。

title: Relative Clauses
sub: 關係子句用 who／which／that／whose／where／when 引導，補充說明名詞；限定子句不加逗號、非限定加逗號。

form.p: 名詞 + 關係代名詞 + 子句

uses.t: who 人／which 物／that 皆可

uses.d: 限定無逗號（必要資訊）；非限定有逗號（額外資訊）且不用 that。

ex.s: My brother, who lives in Taipei, is a teacher.

uses.d: 當受詞時 that/which/who(m) 可略。

mistakes.no: The man which lives next door is kind.
mistakes.yes: The man who lives next door is kind.
mistakes.why: 人用 who，不用 which。

mistakes.no: My mother, that is a nurse, works hard.
mistakes.yes: My mother, who is a nurse, works hard.
mistakes.why: 非限定子句不用 that，用 who。

mistakes.no: This is the house where I live in it.
mistakes.yes: This is the house where I live.
mistakes.why: where 已含 in，不再加 in it。

mistakes.no: The boy who his bag is lost cried.
mistakes.yes: The boy whose bag is lost cried.
mistakes.why: 表「…的」用所有格 whose。

tip: 人用 who、物用 which、限定子句兩者皆可用 that；非限定子句加逗號、不用 that；where/when 已含介系詞；受詞關代可省略。

q.q: That's the woman ___ won the prize.
q.why: 人用 who。

q.q: I bought a phone ___ has a great camera.
q.why: 物用 which。

q.q: She's the friend ___ sister is an actress.
q.why: 表「…的」用 whose。

q.q: Paris, ___ is the capital of France, is beautiful.
q.why: 非限定子句用 which，不用 that。

q.q: This is the café ___ we first met.
q.why: 地點用 where。

q.q: The book ___ (關代) I borrowed is overdue.
q.why: 物用 that/which（也可省略）。

q.sent: The car which engine broke is mine .
q.why: 表「…的」用 whose → The car whose engine…。

q.sent: The woman who called left a message
q.why: 人當主詞用 who。

title: Participle Clauses
sub: 分詞構句用現在分詞（V-ing，主動）或過去分詞（p.p.，被動）簡化子句，讓句子更精練；分詞的主詞須與主句一致。

form.p: V-ing／p.p.（+,）+ 主句

ex.s: Written in English, it's easy to read.

uses.d: 分詞的主詞＝主句主詞，否則變 dangling。

mistakes.no: Walking home, the rain started.
mistakes.yes: Walking home, I got caught in the rain.
mistakes.why: 分詞主詞須與主句一致（雨不會走路）。

mistakes.no: Finished the work, I went home.
mistakes.yes: Having finished the work, I went home.
mistakes.why: 主動且先完成用 Having + 過去分詞。

mistakes.no: Writing in a hurry, many mistakes were made.
mistakes.yes: Writing in a hurry, I made many mistakes.
mistakes.why: 主詞須一致（是我在寫）。

tip: 主動用 V-ing、被動用過去分詞、先完成用 having + p.p.；分詞的隱藏主詞一定要和主句主詞相同，否則就是 dangling 錯誤。

q.q: ___ the news, she burst into tears.
q.why: 主動簡化用現在分詞 Hearing。

q.q: ___ in 1850, the castle attracts many tourists.
q.why: 城堡被建，用過去分詞 Built。

q.q: ___ lunch, they continued working.
q.why: 先吃完再工作 → Having had。

q.q: Which sentence is correct (no dangling)?
opts: Running fast, the bus was missed.
Running fast, I still missed the bus.
q.why: 分詞主詞與主句一致（我在跑）。

q.q: ___ what to say, he stayed silent.
q.why: 主動否定分詞 Not knowing。

q.q: ___ (finish) her meal, she paid and left.
q.why: Having finished。

q.sent: Opening the door , a cold wind rushed in .
q.why: 分詞主詞須一致（是人開門）→ Opening the door, I felt…。

q.sent: Feeling sick she left early
q.why: 現在分詞表原因。

title: Reported Speech
sub: 間接引述把直接引語改述：時態往後退一格，人稱、時間與地點詞也跟著改變。

form.p: said (that) + 時態後退的子句
ex: "I am tired." → He said he was tired.
"I will go." → She said she would go.

uses.d: is→was, will→would, can→could, do→did, have done→had done。

ex.s: "I live here." → He said he lived there.

uses.d: now→then, today→that day, here→there, tomorrow→the next day。
ask + if/whether 或 wh-，主詞+動詞不倒裝。

ex.s: "Where do you live?" → He asked where I lived.
"Sit down." → She told me to sit down.

mistakes.no: He said he is tired.
mistakes.yes: He said he was tired.
mistakes.why: 引述動詞過去式，子句時態要後退。

mistakes.no: She asked where do I live.
mistakes.yes: She asked where I lived.
mistakes.why: 間接問句不倒裝，且時態後退。

mistakes.no: He told me go home.
mistakes.yes: He told me to go home.
mistakes.why: 間接命令用 tell sb to + 原形。

mistakes.no: She said me that she was busy.
mistakes.yes: She told me that she was busy. / She said that she was busy.
mistakes.why: say 不接人；接人用 tell。

tip: 引述動詞過去式時，子句時態後退一格、人稱與時地詞改變；間接問句用 if/wh- 且不倒裝；間接命令用 tell sb to + 原形；say 不接人、tell 接人。

q.q: "I am busy." → She said she ___ busy.
q.why: is 後退為 was。

q.q: "I will help." → He said he ___ help.
q.why: will 後退為 would。

q.q: She asked me where ___.
q.why: 間接問句不倒裝＋後退 → I lived。

q.q: The teacher told us ___ quiet.
q.why: 間接命令 tell sb to + 原形。

q.q: Choose the correct report of "I saw her yesterday."
opts: He said he saw her yesterday.
He said he had seen her the day before.
He said he sees her yesterday.
He told he had seen her.
q.why: 過去完成後退＋yesterday→the day before。

q.q: "I can swim." → He said he ___ swim.
q.why: can → could。

q.sent: She said that she will come later .
q.why: said 之後 will 後退為 would。

q.sent: He asked if I was ready
q.why: 間接 yes/no 問句用 if + 不倒裝。

title: Adverb Clauses
sub: When, because, if, although, so that — clauses that tell when, why and under what condition.

form.p: main clause + conjunction + S + V  (or:  Conjunction + S + V, main clause)
ex: I stayed home because it was raining.
Although she was tired, she kept working.

uses.t: Time 時間 (when, while, before, after, until, as soon as)
uses.d: Say when the main action happens. The time clause can go first (with a comma) or second.

ex.s: As soon as I got home, I called you.
While I was cooking, the phone rang.

uses.d: Give the reason for the main action.

ex.s: We cancelled the picnic because it rained.
Since you're busy, I'll ask someone else.

uses.t: Condition 條件 (if, unless, as long as)
uses.d: Say what must be true for the main action to happen.

ex.s: You can't enter unless you have a ticket.

uses.t: Contrast / Concession 讓步 (although, though, even though, while)
uses.d: Show a surprising contrast — the main clause still happens.

ex.s: Although it was expensive, she bought it.
He went out even though he was sick.

uses.t: Purpose & Result 目的與結果 (so that · so/such … that)
uses.d: Purpose = the goal; Result = what follows.

ex.s: She spoke slowly so that everyone could understand.
It was so cold that the lake froze.
It was such a good film that I saw it twice.

mistakes.no: Although it was late, but we kept talking.
mistakes.yes: Although it was late, we kept talking.
mistakes.why: although 和 but 不能同時用；中文「雖然…但是…」，英文只留一個。

mistakes.no: When I will arrive, I will call you.
mistakes.yes: When I arrive, I will call you.
mistakes.why: 時間／條件副詞子句談未來時用現在式，不用 will。

mistakes.no: Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
mistakes.yes: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
mistakes.why: unless 已含「如果不」，後面不再加否定。

mistakes.no: Because he was tired. He went to bed.
mistakes.yes: Because he was tired, he went to bed.
mistakes.why: 副詞子句不能單獨成句，要接主句（用逗號連接）。

tip: 子句放句首要加逗號（When it rains, …）；放句尾通常不加（… when it rains）。時間／條件子句談未來一律用現在式。

q.q: ___ it was raining, we stayed inside.
q.why: 表原因 → Because。

q.q: I'll text you ___ I arrive at the station.
q.why: 時間「一…就…」→ as soon as。

q.q: ___ he studied hard, he still failed the test.
q.why: 努力卻失敗＝讓步對比 → Although。

q.q: You won't improve ___ you practice every day.
q.why: unless = 如果不。

q.q: She saved money ___ she could travel abroad.
q.why: 表目的 → so that + S + could。

q.q: We'll go to the beach ___ the weather is nice tomorrow.
q.why: 真實未來條件 → if（子句用現在式 is）。

q.q: It was ___ a boring movie that I fell asleep.
q.why: such + a + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that（表結果）。

q.sent: When the alarm rang everyone ran outside
q.why: 時間子句置前，後接主句。

q.sent: We cancelled the trip although it rained .
q.why: 下雨是取消的原因 → because，不是讓步 although。

q.sent: He failed the test because he studied hard .
q.why: 努力卻失敗＝讓步對比 → although。

zh: V-ing 與 p.p. 的差異
title: V-ing or p.p.? Active vs Passive Participles
sub: Is the house collapsing, or collapsed? Choosing between -ing and -ed — and using them after with + object.

form.p: V-ing（主動／進行中）　vs　p.p.（被動／已完成的狀態）
ex: He left with the house collapsing behind him.

uses.d: 主詞自己「正在做／正在發生」這個動作。

ex.s: Her hair is blowing in the wind.

uses.d: 看到、聽到某件事「進行的過程」。

uses.t: with + O + V-ing：O 主動做、同時發生
uses.d: 伴隨的背景狀態，O 自己在做這個動作。

ex.s: He ran away with the house collapsing behind him.
ex.n: 他逃跑時，房子正在他身後倒塌

ex.s: We stayed inside with the rain falling outside.
ex.n: 外面下著雨，我們待在室內

uses.t: with + O + p.p.：O 被動或呈現某狀態
uses.d: O 是「被…」或「…著」的結果狀態。

ex.s: She sat quietly with her eyes closed.
ex.n: 她閉著眼睛安靜地坐著

ex.s: He walked home with his phone broken.

uses.t: 不及物動詞的 p.p. = 已完成
uses.d: fall、collapse 沒有被動；fallen / collapsed 表示動作已完成。

ex.s: The leaves are falling. / The leaves have fallen.
ex.n: 正在落下 ／ 已經落下

mistakes.no: She sat quietly with her eyes closing.
mistakes.yes: She sat quietly with her eyes closed.
mistakes.why: 眼睛是「被閉上」的狀態，用 p.p.。

mistakes.no: The road is repairing now.
mistakes.yes: The road is being repaired now.
mistakes.why: 路是被修的，進行被動 be being + p.p.。

mistakes.no: We stayed in with the rain fell outside.
mistakes.yes: We stayed in with the rain falling outside.
mistakes.why: with + O 後面不能用過去式動詞，雨在落下用 falling。

mistakes.no: I saw the leaves fallen from the tree.
mistakes.yes: I saw the leaves falling from the tree.
mistakes.why: 看到「落下的過程」用 V-ing；fallen 是已落下的結果。

tip: 判斷 V-ing 或 p.p.，不只看中文的「正在」或「被」：看 O 是自己在做動作（V-ing）、還是被做／呈現結果狀態（p.p.）；動作進行中用 V-ing，已完成的狀態用 p.p.；fall、collapse 這類不及物動詞沒有被動，p.p. 只表示「已完成」。

q.q: Look! The leaves are ___ from the tree.
q.why: 正在落下（進行中），用 falling。

q.q: The window is ___. Please call someone to fix it.
q.why: 窗戶「破了」是結果狀態，用 broken。

q.q: She walked with her hair ___ in the wind.
q.why: 頭髮自己在飄動（主動、同時發生），用 blowing。

q.q: He sat there with his arms ___.
q.why: 手臂是「被交叉」（擺成交叉的狀態），用 crossed。

q.q: The road is being ___ now, so we must take another way.
q.why: 路是被修的，進行被動 is being + p.p.。

q.q: We stayed inside with the rain ___ outside.
q.why: 雨正在下（主動、進行中），with + O + falling。

q.q: He ran away with the house ___ (collapse) behind him.
q.why: 房子自己正在倒塌，用 collapsing。

q.q: She fell asleep with the TV ___ (turn) on.
q.why: 電視是「被打開」的狀態，用 turned。

q.sent: She walked with her hair blown in the wind .
q.why: 頭髮自己在飄動，用 blowing。

q.sent: He stood there with the house collapsing behind him
q.why: with + O + V-ing 表伴隨狀態。

title: Second Conditional
sub: 第二條件句 If + 過去簡單式, would + 原形：表示與「現在事實相反」或不太可能發生的假設。

form.p: If + 過去簡單式, 主詞 + would + 原形
ex: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.

ex.s: If I had a car, I would drive there.
If I met a ghost, I would run.

uses.t: 給建議 If I were you

ex.s: If I had time, I could help.

mistakes.no: If I was you, I would leave.
mistakes.yes: If I were you, I would leave.
mistakes.why: 假設語氣 be 動詞用 were。

mistakes.no: If I would have money, I would travel.
mistakes.yes: If I had money, I would travel.
mistakes.why: if 子句用過去式，不用 would。

mistakes.no: If he studied harder, he will pass.
mistakes.yes: If he studied harder, he would pass.
mistakes.why: 與現實相反，主句用 would。

tip: 第二條件句＝與現在相反：If + 過去式, would + 原形；be 動詞一律用 were；if 子句絕不用 would；給建議用 If I were you, I would…。

q.q: If I ___ a bird, I would fly away.
q.why: 假設語氣用 were。

q.q: If she had more time, she ___ learn piano.
q.why: 主句用 would。

q.q: If I ___ the answer, I would tell you.
q.why: if 子句用過去式 knew。

q.q: ___ I were you, I'd take the job.
q.why: 假設用 If。

q.q: Which is correct?
opts: If I was rich, I will help.
If I were rich, I would help.
If I would be rich, I help.
If I am rich, I would help.
q.why: were + would 的第二條件句。

q.q: If he ___ (not be) so busy, he would join us.
q.why: 假設語氣否定 weren't。

q.sent: If I would win , I would travel the world .
q.why: if 子句用過去式 won，不用 would。

q.sent: If I had wings I would fly
q.why: 與現在相反：過去式 + would。

title: Third Conditional
sub: 第三條件句 If + had + 過去分詞, would have + 過去分詞：表示與「過去事實相反」的假設（當時沒發生）。

form.p: If + 過去完成式, 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞
ex: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If you had told me, I would have helped.

ex.s: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train.
If I had known, I would have come.

uses.t: if 子句用 had + 過去分詞
主句 would have + 過去分詞

uses.d: 過去的因＋現在的果可混用。

ex.s: If I had saved money, I would be rich now.

mistakes.no: If I would have known, I would have come.
mistakes.yes: If I had known, I would have come.
mistakes.why: if 子句用過去完成式 had known，不用 would have。

mistakes.no: If I had studied, I would passed.
mistakes.yes: If I had studied, I would have passed.
mistakes.why: 主句用 would have + 過去分詞。

mistakes.no: If he had knew, he would have told me.
mistakes.yes: If he had known, he would have told me.
mistakes.why: had 後面用過去分詞 known。

tip: 第三條件句＝與過去相反：If + had + 過去分詞, would have + 過去分詞；if 子句絕不用 would have；用來表達對過去的後悔或假想。

q.q: If you had asked, I ___ you.
q.why: 主句 would have + 過去分詞。

q.q: If I ___ earlier, I wouldn't have missed the bus.
q.why: if 子句用過去完成式 had left。

q.q: She ___ the exam if she had revised.
q.why: would have passed。

q.q: If they had known the risk, they ___ differently.
q.why: would have acted。

q.q: Which is correct?
opts: If I would have seen it, I'd have said.
If I had seen it, I would have said.
If I saw it, I would have said.
If I have seen it, I said.
q.why: had + p.p. / would have + p.p.。

q.q: If we ___ (take) a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
q.why: had taken。

q.sent: If I had knew , I would have helped .
q.why: had 後用過去分詞 known。

q.sent: If she had called I would have answered
q.why: 第三條件句結構。

title: Noun Clauses & the Subjunctive
sub: 名詞子句用 that／wh-／whether(if) 引導，當句子的主詞、受詞或補語，等於一個名詞的角色。

form.p: that／wh-／whether + 主詞 + 動詞（不倒裝）

ex.s: I believe (that) you can do it.

uses.d: 間接問句用「主詞 + 動詞」。

mistakes.no: I don't know what does she want.
mistakes.yes: I don't know what she wants.
mistakes.why: 名詞子句不倒裝，不用助動詞 does。

mistakes.no: I wonder that he will come.
mistakes.yes: I wonder whether/if he will come.
mistakes.why: 表「是否」用 whether/if，不用 that。

mistakes.no: Tell me where is the station.
mistakes.yes: Tell me where the station is.
mistakes.why: 間接問句語序：主詞 + 動詞。

tip: 名詞子句當名詞用（主詞／受詞／補語）：that（陳述）、wh-（疑問詞）、whether/if（是否）；間接問句一律「主詞+動詞」不倒裝、不加 do/does/did。

q.q: I don't know ___ he lives.
q.why: 名詞子句不倒裝 → where he lives。

q.q: Do you know ___ the shop is open?
q.why: 是否 → whether/if。

q.q: ___ he said was a complete lie.
q.why: 當主詞的名詞子句用 What。

q.q: I'm not sure ___ to do next.
q.why: wh- + to V 名詞片語 what to do。

q.q: Which is correct?
opts: I wonder why is she sad.
I wonder why she is sad.
I wonder that she is sad.
I wonder why does she sad.
q.why: 間接問句不倒裝。

q.q: Tell me ___ (what) you need.
q.why: 名詞子句 what you need。

q.sent: I can't remember where did I put it .
q.why: 間接問句不倒裝 → where I put it。

q.sent: I know that you are right
q.why: that 子句當受詞。

title: Wish: Present
sub: wish + 過去式表達「與現在相反」的願望；wish + would 表達對他人行為的不滿或期望。

form.p: wish + 過去簡單式　/　wish + would + 原形

uses.t: wish + 過去式：與現在相反

uses.d: 希望別人改變行為（帶抱怨）。

mistakes.no: I wish I am taller.
mistakes.yes: I wish I were taller.
mistakes.why: 與現在相反用過去式／were。

mistakes.no: I wish I can drive.
mistakes.yes: I wish I could drive.
mistakes.why: wish 後用 could，不用 can。

mistakes.no: I wish you will be quiet.
mistakes.yes: I wish you would be quiet.
mistakes.why: 希望別人改變行為用 would。

tip: wish + 過去式／were＝與現在相反的願望；wish + could＝希望有能力；wish + would＝希望別人改變行為；If only 語氣更強。

q.q: I wish I ___ how to swim.
q.why: 與現在相反用過去式 knew。

q.q: She wishes she ___ taller.
q.why: wish 後 be 用 were。

q.q: I wish I ___ speak French fluently.
q.why: 能力願望用 could。

q.q: I wish my neighbors ___ turn down the music.
q.why: 希望別人改變行為用 would。

q.q: Which expresses a present regret?
opts: I wish I had a car.
q.why: wish + 過去式 had。

q.q: I wish it ___ (not be) so cold today.
q.why: wish + weren't。

q.sent: I wish I can come to your party .
q.why: wish 後用 could。

q.sent: I wish I had a dog
q.why: wish + 過去式＝與現在相反。

title: Gerunds & Infinitives
sub: 動名詞（V-ing）與不定詞（to V）當受詞：有些動詞只接其一，有些兩者皆可但意思不同。

form.p: 動詞 + V-ing　/　動詞 + to V
ex: stop smoking（戒）vs stop to smoke（停下來去抽）

uses.d: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, suggest, keep, practice。
want, decide, hope, plan, agree, promise, need, offer。

ex.s: remember to lock（記得去鎖）vs remember locking（記得鎖過）

mistakes.no: I enjoy to swim.
mistakes.yes: I enjoy swimming.
mistakes.why: enjoy 後面接動名詞。

mistakes.no: She wants going home.
mistakes.yes: She wants to go home.
mistakes.why: want 後面接不定詞。

mistakes.no: He is good at to cook.
mistakes.yes: He is good at cooking.
mistakes.why: 介系詞後用動名詞。

tip: enjoy/finish/avoid/mind 等接 V-ing；want/decide/hope/plan 等接 to V；介系詞後一律 V-ing；remember/stop/try 兩用但意思不同。

q.q: Would you mind ___ the window?
q.why: mind 後接動名詞。

q.q: They decided ___ a new house.
q.why: decide 後接不定詞。

q.q: I'm thinking ___ a language course.
q.why: 介系詞 about 後用動名詞。

q.q: Remember ___ the door when you leave. (未來動作)
q.why: remember to do＝記得去做。

q.q: He stopped ___ because it was bad for his health.
q.why: stop doing＝戒掉／停止做某事。

q.q: She avoids ___ (eat) junk food.
q.why: avoid + V-ing。

q.sent: I hope seeing you soon .
q.why: hope 後接不定詞 → hope to see。

q.sent: I enjoy listening to music
q.why: enjoy + 動名詞。

title: Phrasal Verbs
sub: 片語動詞＝動詞 + 介副詞，整體意思常與字面不同；分及物／不及物、可分離／不可分離。

form.p: 動詞 + 介副詞（+ 受詞）

uses.d: 受詞是代名詞時必須放中間。

ex.s: The car broke down. / She grew up here.
find out, take off, give up, look for, carry on

mistakes.no: Please turn off it.
mistakes.yes: Please turn it off.
mistakes.why: 代名詞受詞要放可分離片語動詞中間。

mistakes.no: I'll look after of the children.
mistakes.yes: I'll look after the children.
mistakes.why: look after 後直接接受詞，不加 of。

mistakes.no: He gave up to smoke.
mistakes.yes: He gave up smoking.
mistakes.why: give up 後接動名詞。

tip: 片語動詞整體記意思；可分離的，代名詞受詞必須放中間（turn it off）；不可分離的受詞放後面（look after her）；後面接動詞時多用動名詞。

q.q: My car broke ___ on the highway.
q.why: break down＝拋錨。

q.q: Can you turn ___? It's too loud.
q.why: 代名詞放中間 → turn it off。

q.q: She looks ___ her little brother every day.
q.why: look after＝照顧。

q.q: I need to find ___ the truth.
q.why: find out＝查明。

q.q: He grew ___ in a small village.
q.why: grow up＝長大。

q.q: Don't give ___! Keep trying.
q.why: give up＝放棄。

q.sent: Please take off them before you come in .
q.why: 代名詞放中間 → take them off。

q.sent: I ran into an old friend
q.why: run into＝偶遇（不可分離）。

title: Modals of Deduction
sub: 用情態動詞表推測：must（很確定是）、can't（不可能）、might／may／could（也許）；推測過去用 + have + 過去分詞。

form.p: must／can't／might + 原形　/　+ have + 過去分詞（過去）

ex.s: The lights are on; they must be home.

uses.d: 否定的確定推測（不用 mustn't）。

mistakes.no: He must to be rich.
mistakes.yes: He must be rich.
mistakes.why: 情態動詞後直接接原形，不加 to。

mistakes.no: She must has left already.
mistakes.yes: She must have left already.
mistakes.why: 過去推測用 must have + 過去分詞。

mistakes.no: He mustn't be at home (meaning impossible).
mistakes.yes: He can't be at home.
mistakes.why: 表「不可能」用 can't，不用 mustn't。

tip: 推測用 must（很確定是）、can't（不可能，不用 mustn't）、might/may/could（也許）；講過去的推測加 have + 過去分詞；情態後接原形不加 to。

q.q: The ground is wet. It ___ rained.
q.why: 過去肯定推測 must have + 過去分詞。

q.q: You've been up all night — you ___ be exhausted.
q.why: 很確定 → must be。

q.q: That ___ be John; he's in Japan right now.
q.why: 不可能 → can't be。

q.q: I'm not sure, but she ___ know his number.
q.why: 不確定 → might。

q.q: He failed? He ___ studied enough.
q.why: 過去否定推測 → can't have studied。

q.q: The phone's off. She ___ (must) have gone to bed.
q.why: must have gone。

q.sent: They must to be the new neighbors .
q.why: 情態後接原形，去掉 to → must be。

q.sent: She might be at work now
q.why: might + 原形＝也許。

zh: 字首 un- / re- / im- / in-
title: Prefixes: un-, re-, im-/in-
sub: 字首加在字根「前面」改變字義：否定（un-, in-, dis-）、重複／返回（re-）、程度（over-, under-）、時間（pre-, post-）。

form.p: 字首 + 字根

mistakes.no: That's unpossible.
mistakes.yes: That's impossible.
mistakes.why: p 前的否定字首用 im-。

mistakes.no: I unagree with you.
mistakes.yes: I disagree with you.
mistakes.why: agree 的反義用 dis-。

mistakes.no: It's inlegal.
mistakes.yes: It's illegal.
mistakes.why: l 前的否定字首用 il-。

tip: 字首改變字義：否定 un-/in-/dis-（in- 在 b,m,p 前變 im-、l 前 il-、r 前 ir-）、re-＝再／返回、over-/under-＝過度/不足、pre-/post-＝前/後。

q.q: The opposite of 'possible' is ___.
q.why: p 前用 im- → impossible。

q.q: To do something again is to ___ it.
q.why: re-＝再一次 → redo。

q.q: The opposite of 'regular' is ___.
q.why: r 前用 ir- → irregular。

q.q: If you eat too much, you ___.
q.why: over-＝過度 → overeat。

q.q: The opposite of 'agree' is ___.
q.why: agree 的反義 → disagree。

q.q: Something not legal is ___ (字首+legal).
q.why: l 前用 il- → illegal。

q.sent: His handwriting is unpossible to read .
q.why: p 前用 im- → impossible。

q.sent: Please rewrite the first paragraph
q.why: re-＝重新。

title: Suffixes: -er, -able, -ness
sub: 字尾加在字根「後面」改變詞性：名詞（-tion, -ment, -ness）、形容詞（-ful, -less, -able）、副詞（-ly）、動詞（-ize, -en）。

form.p: 字根 + 字尾（決定詞性）

uses.d: 看字尾判斷是名詞、形容詞還是副詞。

ex.s: a careful driver（形容名詞）／drive carefully（修飾動詞）

mistakes.no: He is a carefully driver.
mistakes.yes: He is a careful driver.
mistakes.why: 名詞前用形容詞 careful。

mistakes.no: She sings beautiful.
mistakes.yes: She sings beautifully.
mistakes.why: 修飾動詞用副詞 beautifully。

mistakes.no: I value your happyness.
mistakes.yes: I value your happiness.
mistakes.why: y 結尾加字尾時 y 改 i → happiness。

tip: 字尾決定詞性：-tion/-ment/-ness＝名詞、-ful/-less/-able＝形容詞、-ly＝副詞、-ize/-en＝動詞；看字尾就能判斷字在句中的角色。

q.q: She solved the problem ___.
q.why: 修飾動詞用副詞 easily。

q.q: His ___ to the team was huge. (名詞)
q.why: 名詞字尾 -tion → contribution。

q.q: This tool is very ___. (形容詞)
q.why: 形容詞字尾 -ful → useful。

q.q: We need to ___ the process. (動詞：使現代化)
q.why: 動詞字尾 -ize → modernize。

q.q: They watched in ___. (名詞)
q.why: 名詞 silence。

q.q: happy + ness → ___
q.why: y 改 i → happiness。

q.sent: He speaks English perfect .
q.why: 修飾動詞用副詞 → perfectly。

q.sent: She is a wonderful teacher
q.why: 名詞前用形容詞 wonderful。

title: The Infinitive (to + V)
sub: to + 原形動詞：表目的、接在形容詞／名詞後、當主詞或受詞，還有「疑問詞 + to V」。

form.p: to + base verb (原形動詞)

uses.t: Purpose 表目的 (to / in order to)
uses.d: 說「為了…」，用 to + 原形，不用 for + V。

ex.s: I got up early to catch the train.
She's saving money to buy a bike.

uses.t: After adjectives 接在形容詞後 (adj + to V)
uses.d: happy / easy / hard / important… 後面接 to V。

uses.t: As subject / object 當主詞或受詞
uses.d: 不定詞可當主詞或受詞；當主詞時常用虛主詞 It 代替。

ex.n: = It takes time to learn a language.

uses.t: Wh- word + to V 疑問詞 + 不定詞
uses.d: what / how / where / when + to V，等於一個名詞片語。

uses.t: Verb + object + to V 動詞 + 受詞 + 不定詞
uses.d: want / ask / tell / allow / expect + 人 + to V。

mistakes.no: I came here for study.
mistakes.yes: I came here to study.
mistakes.why: 表目的用 to＋原形，不用 for＋V。

mistakes.no: It's important learning grammar.
mistakes.yes: It's important to learn grammar.
mistakes.why: 形容詞後面接不定詞 to learn，不用 V-ing。

mistakes.no: She wants that I go.
mistakes.yes: She wants me to go.
mistakes.why: want 用「受詞＋to V」，不用 that 子句。

mistakes.no: I know how do it.
mistakes.yes: I know how to do it.
mistakes.why: 疑問詞後接 to V：how to do。

tip: 表目的＝to＋原形（＝in order to）；中文的「為了讀書」不是 for study，而是 to study。形容詞後、want/ask/tell 後也都接 to V。

q.q: I went to the store ___ some milk.
q.why: 表目的 → to + 原形 buy。

q.q: It's not easy ___ a new habit.
q.why: 形容詞 easy 後接不定詞 to start。

q.q: My parents want me ___ a doctor.
q.why: want + 受詞 + to V → to become。

q.q: I'm not sure ___ next.
q.why: 疑問詞 + to V → what to do。

q.q: ___ a language well takes years of practice.
q.why: 不定詞當主詞 → To speak…（= It takes years to speak）。

q.q: She stayed up late ___ (finish) her project.
q.why: 為了完成 → to finish。

q.q: Can you tell me how ___ (use) this app?
q.why: how + to V → how to use。

q.sent: He asked her to close the window
q.why: ask + 受詞 + to V。

q.sent: It is dangerous to drive too fast
q.why: 虛主詞 It + be + adj + to V。

q.sent: I came here for study .
q.why: 表目的用 to＋原形：to study。

title: Dummy 'It': Subject & Object
sub: It is + 形容詞 + to V／that…（虛主詞）；find／make／think it + 形容詞 + to V（虛受詞）—— 把長長的真主詞／真受詞往後移。

form.p: It + be + adj + to V / that-clause   ·   V + it + adj + to V

uses.t: 虛主詞 It + be + 形容詞 + to V
uses.d: 真主詞（to V）太長，就先用 It 占位，把真主詞放句尾。

ex.n: 真主詞 = to learn new things

uses.t: 虛主詞 It + be + 形容詞 + that 子句
uses.d: 真主詞是 that 子句時，一樣用 It 占位。

uses.t: 虛主詞 It 談天氣／時間／距離
uses.d: 沒有真正的主詞時，用 It 當形式上的主詞。

uses.t: 虛受詞 It：find/make/think + it + 形容詞 + to V
uses.d: 「動詞＋受詞＋補語」句型裡，真受詞（to V／that）太長，用 it 占位。

ex.n: 真受詞是 that 子句

mistakes.no: Is important to rest.
mistakes.yes: It is important to rest.
mistakes.why: 虛主詞 It 不能省略，英文句子要有主詞。

mistakes.no: To learn Chinese is difficult for beginners, it is.
mistakes.yes: It is difficult for beginners to learn Chinese.
mistakes.why: 真主詞太長，用 It 占位，把 to V 放句尾最自然。

mistakes.no: I find hard to sleep at night.
mistakes.yes: I find it hard to sleep at night.
mistakes.why: 虛受詞 it 不能省：find + it + adj + to V。

mistakes.no: The noise made difficult to concentrate.
mistakes.yes: The noise made it difficult to concentrate.
mistakes.why: make + it + adj + to V，虛受詞 it 不能省。

tip: 真主詞／真受詞（to V 或 that 子句）太長，就先放 it 占位，把真的移到句尾。虛受詞只出現在 find／make／think／consider／feel 這類「動詞＋受詞＋補語」句型裡。

q.q: ___ is important to drink enough water.
q.why: 虛主詞 → It is important to…。

q.q: I find ___ difficult to wake up early.
q.why: 虛受詞 → find it + adj + to V。

q.q: It's a shame ___ you missed the show.
q.why: 真主詞是 that 子句 → It's a shame that…。

q.q: The storm made ___ impossible to travel.
q.why: make + it + adj + to V，虛受詞 it。

q.q: ___ takes courage to say sorry.
q.why: 虛主詞 It + takes + to V。

q.q: ___ is nice to meet you. （填虛主詞）
q.why: It is nice to meet you。

q.q: We consider ___ wrong to cheat. （填虛受詞）
q.why: consider + it + adj + to V。

q.sent: It is easy to make this cake
q.why: 虛主詞 It + be + adj + to V。

q.sent: She found it strange to be alone
q.why: find + it + adj + to V，虛受詞。

q.sent: It is difficult to learning Chinese .
q.why: to 後面接原形：to learn。

sub: 使役式 have／get + 受詞 + 過去分詞：安排、請或讓「別人」做某事——事情是別人做的，不是自己動手。

form.p: have／get + 受詞(物) + 過去分詞

uses.d: 安排別人（專業人員）做某事。
較口語，意思與 have 相同。
和自己動手的句子區分。
變的是 have／get，受詞 + 過去分詞不變。
have + 物 + 過去分詞，表示東西被（偷、弄壞）。

mistakes.no: I cut my hair yesterday. (at the salon)
mistakes.yes: I had my hair cut yesterday.
mistakes.why: 別人幫你剪，用 have + 受詞 + 過去分詞。

mistakes.no: I had my car wash.
mistakes.yes: I had my car washed.
mistakes.why: 事情是被做的，要用過去分詞 washed。

mistakes.no: I had repaired my watch. (by a shop)
mistakes.yes: I had my watch repaired.
mistakes.why: 使役語序：受詞在前、過去分詞在後。

mistakes.no: I got stolen my phone.
mistakes.yes: I had my phone stolen.
mistakes.why: 遭遇壞事用 have／get + 受詞 + 過去分詞，語序是受詞在前。

tip: have／get + 受詞 + 過去分詞＝請／讓別人做某事（事情是被處理的，所以用過去分詞）；語序是受詞在前；也用來講遭遇壞事 (have sth stolen)。

q.q: I need to ___ my eyes tested.
q.why: 使役用 have + 受詞 + 過去分詞。

q.q: We had the roof ___ last week.
q.why: 事情是被做的，用過去分詞 repaired。

q.q: She ___ her photo taken for the passport.
q.why: got + 受詞 + 過去分詞＝請人做。

q.q: Which means someone else did it?
q.why: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞＝別人做的。

q.q: He ___ his wallet stolen on the train.
q.why: 遭遇壞事用 had + 受詞 + 過去分詞。

q.q: I'm going to ___ (get) my suit ___ (clean).
q.why: get my suit cleaned。

q.sent: She had her nails paint yesterday .
q.why: 被做的動作用過去分詞 → painted。

q.sent: We had the car serviced
q.why: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞。

sub: 混合條件句：if 子句和主句的「時間」不一樣——過去的假設影響現在的結果，或現在的狀態影響過去的結果。

form.p: 過去因→現在果：If + had + 過去分詞, 主詞 + would + 原形　／　現在因→過去果：If + 過去式, 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞
ex: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If I weren't so shy, I would have asked her.

uses.t: 過去條件 → 現在結果
uses.d: If + had + 過去分詞, would + 原形；常配 now／today。

ex.s: If I had saved money, I would be rich now.

uses.t: 現在狀態 → 過去結果
uses.d: If + 過去式, would have + 過去分詞。

ex.s: If I were braver, I would have spoken up.

uses.d: 看 now／today／these days 等線索決定結果時態。

ex.s: If she had taken the job, she would live in Tokyo today.

uses.d: 假設語氣所有人稱用 were。

ex.s: If he were taller, he would have made the team.

uses.t: 和單純第二／第三條件句的差別
uses.d: 單純條件句 if 和結果時間一致；混合則不一致。

ex.s: 第三：If I had studied, I would have passed.（都過去）

mistakes.no: If I studied harder in school, I would have a better job now.
mistakes.yes: If I had studied harder in school, I would have a better job now.
mistakes.why: 過去的假設（當年在學校）要用過去完成式 had studied。

mistakes.no: If I had won, I would have been happy now.
mistakes.yes: If I had won, I would be happy now.
mistakes.why: 有 now，現在結果用 would + 原形 be。

mistakes.no: If I was you, I would have said no.
mistakes.yes: If I were you, I would have said no.
mistakes.why: 假設語氣 be 動詞用 were。

mistakes.no: If I would have known, I would be there.
mistakes.yes: If I had known, I would be there.
mistakes.why: if 子句用過去完成式 had known，不用 would have。

tip: 混合條件句的 if 和結果時間不同：過去假設→現在結果 (had + 過去分詞 … would + 原形)；現在狀態→過去結果 (過去式 … would have + 過去分詞)；看 now／today 等線索判斷結果時態；be 用 were。

q.q: If I had taken that job, I ___ in London now.
q.why: 過去因→現在果（now）→ would + 原形 live。

q.q: If she weren't afraid of flying, she ___ us last summer.
q.why: 現在狀態→過去結果 → would have visited。

q.q: If I ___ more sleep last night, I wouldn't be so tired now.
q.why: 過去條件用過去完成式 had got。

q.q: If he ___ more patient, he wouldn't have quit so soon.
q.why: 現在個性（were）→過去結果。

q.q: Which is a mixed conditional?
opts: If it rains, I stay in.
If I had studied, I would have passed.
If I had been born rich, I wouldn't work today.
If I were you, I'd rest.
q.why: 過去條件 + 現在結果 (today) ＝混合。

q.q: If we ___ (not miss) the flight, we would be on the beach now.
q.why: 過去條件 hadn't missed。

q.sent: If I was taller I would have made the team .
q.why: 假設語氣 be 動詞用 were。

q.sent: If I had saved more I would be richer now
q.why: 過去因→現在果。

sub: so／such … that 表達「如此…以致於」：so + 形容詞／副詞；such + (a/an) + 名詞片語；後面接 that 結果子句。

form.p: so + 形容詞/副詞 + that …　／　such + (a/an +) 形容詞 + 名詞 + that …
ex: It was so cold that the lake froze.
It was such a cold day that we stayed in.
He ran so fast that I lost him.

uses.d: so 直接加形容詞或副詞。

ex.s: She was so tired that she fell asleep.
He spoke so quietly that no one heard.

uses.t: such + a/an + 形容詞 + 單數名詞

ex.s: It was such a good film that I watched it twice.

uses.t: such + 形容詞 + 複數／不可數名詞
uses.d: 複數或不可數名詞前不加 a/an。

ex.s: They were such kind people that everyone loved them.
It was such bad weather that we left.

uses.d: 講數量用 so，不用 such。

ex.s: There were so many people that we couldn't move.
I had so much work that I stayed late.

uses.d: 口語中 that 常省略。

ex.s: It was so hot (that) I couldn't sleep.

mistakes.no: It was a so cold day that we stayed in.
mistakes.yes: It was such a cold day that we stayed in.
mistakes.why: 名詞片語（a cold day）前用 such。

mistakes.no: She is such tall that she can reach it.
mistakes.yes: She is so tall that she can reach it.
mistakes.why: 形容詞單獨用 so，不用 such。

mistakes.no: It was so a good book that I finished it fast.
mistakes.yes: It was such a good book that I finished it fast.
mistakes.why: so 不接 a/an 名詞片語；用 such a。

mistakes.no: There were such many people that we left.
mistakes.yes: There were so many people that we left.
mistakes.why: 數量 many／much 前用 so，不用 such。

tip: so + 形容詞／副詞；such + (a/an) 形容詞 + 名詞；數量用 so many／much + 名詞；後接 that 結果子句（that 可省略）。要訣：後面是「形容詞／副詞」用 so，是「名詞片語」用 such。

q.q: It was ___ hot that we went swimming.
q.why: 形容詞 hot 前用 so。

q.q: It was ___ interesting lecture that nobody left.
q.why: 名詞片語（an interesting lecture）用 such an。

q.q: They were ___ nice people that we made friends.
q.why: 複數名詞前用 such（不加 a）。

q.q: There was ___ traffic that we missed the start.
q.why: traffic 不可數，數量用 so much。

q.q: He has ___ many friends that he's never lonely.
q.why: many + 名詞用 so。

q.q: It was ___ a boring film ___ I fell asleep.
q.why: such a boring film that…。

q.sent: She gave so a good speech that we cheered .
q.why: 名詞片語 a good speech 前用 such → such a good speech。

q.sent: It was so cold that we left
q.why: so + 形容詞 + that 結果子句。
